parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
), released_claims AS (
  UPDATE public.messages AS inbound
  SET processing_owner = NULL,
      processing_lease_until = NULL,
      processing_completed_at = CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.messages AS lr_any
    WHERE lr_any.in_reply_to_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'turn_anchor_id', '')::uuid, inbound.id) AND lr_any.direction = 'outbound'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(lr.metadata->>'logical_reply_key', ''), lr.idempotency_key) AS logical_key,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lr.part_index) AS index_count,
        MIN(lr.part_index) AS min_index,
        MAX(lr.part_index) AS max_index,
        MIN(lr.part_count) AS min_count,
        MAX(lr.part_count) AS max_count,
        BOOL_AND(COALESCE(
          lr.delivery_status IN ('accepted', 'scheduled', 'sent', 'delivered')
          AND (
            lr.provider_message_sid ~ '^(SM|MM)[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
            OR lr.metadata->>'provider_acceptance_evidence' = 'message_sid'
          )
          AND lr.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM public.messages WHERE id = COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'turn_anchor_id', '')::uuid, inbound.id))
          AND lr.part_index BETWEEN 1 AND lr.part_count
          AND lr.part_count BETWEEN 1 AND 999
          AND lr.idempotency_key = CASE WHEN lr.part_index = 1
            THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(lr.metadata->>'logical_reply_key', ''), lr.idempotency_key)
            ELSE (lr.metadata->>'logical_reply_key') || ':part:' || LPAD(lr.part_index::text, 3, '0') END
          AND (NOT lr.declared OR NULLIF(lr.metadata->>'logical_reply_key', '') IS NOT NULL)
          AND (NOT lr.declared OR jsonb_typeof(lr.metadata->'logical_reply_key') = 'string')
          AND (lr.declared OR lr.idempotency_key NOT LIKE '%:part:%')
        , FALSE)) AS all_accepted
      FROM (
        SELECT source.*,
          source.metadata ?| ARRAY['logical_reply_key', 'part_index', 'part_count'] AS declared,
          CASE WHEN NOT (source.metadata ?| ARRAY['logical_reply_key', 'part_index', 'part_count']) THEN 1
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(source.metadata->'part_index') = 'number' AND source.metadata->>'part_index' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$'
            THEN (source.metadata->>'part_index')::integer END AS part_index,
          CASE WHEN NOT (source.metadata ?| ARRAY['logical_reply_key', 'part_index', 'part_count']) THEN 1
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(source.metadata->'part_count') = 'number' AND source.metadata->>'part_count' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$'
            THEN (source.metadata->>'part_count')::integer END AS part_count
        FROM public.messages AS source
      ) AS lr
      WHERE lr.in_reply_to_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'turn_anchor_id', '')::uuid, inbound.id) AND lr.direction = 'outbound'
      GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(lr.metadata->>'logical_reply_key', ''), lr.idempotency_key)
    ) AS logical_reply
    WHERE logical_reply.logical_key IS NULL
       OR logical_reply.min_count < 1
       OR logical_reply.min_count <> logical_reply.max_count
       OR logical_reply.row_count <> logical_reply.min_count
       OR logical_reply.index_count <> logical_reply.min_count
       OR logical_reply.min_index <> 1
       OR logical_reply.max_index <> logical_reply.min_count
       OR logical_reply.all_accepted IS NOT TRUE
  ) THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      processing_outcome = CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.messages AS outbound WHERE outbound.in_reply_to_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'turn_anchor_id', '')::uuid, inbound.id) AND outbound.direction = 'outbound')
          THEN 'reconciliation'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      metadata = inbound.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'session_ordering_state', CASE
          WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.messages AS outbound WHERE outbound.in_reply_to_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'turn_anchor_id', '')::uuid, inbound.id) AND outbound.direction = 'outbound')
            THEN 'reconciliation'
          ELSE 'queued'
        END,
        'claim_released_by_error_handler_at', NOW()
      )
  FROM input
  WHERE inbound.direction = 'inbound'
    AND inbound.processing_order IS NOT NULL
    AND inbound.processing_completed_at IS NULL
    AND inbound.processing_owner = input.payload->>'execution_id'
  RETURNING inbound.session_id, inbound.processing_outcome
), reset_commercial_context AS (
  UPDATE public.onboarding_sessions AS session
  SET last_question_type = NULL, last_question_at = NULL,
      commercial_context_expires_at = NULL, checkout_authorization_type = NULL,
      checkout_authorized_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE session.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM released_claims WHERE processing_outcome = 'reconciliation')
  RETURNING session.session_id
)
INSERT INTO public.logs (event, severity, error_message, error_context)
SELECT 'global_workflow_error', 'error',
  LEFT(COALESCE(input.payload->>'error_message', 'Unknown workflow error'), 500),
  jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'workflow', NULLIF(input.payload->>'workflow', ''),
    'workflow_id', NULLIF(input.payload->>'workflow_id', ''),
    'lastNodeExecuted', NULLIF(input.payload->>'last_node_executed', ''),
    'execution_id', NULLIF(input.payload->>'execution_id', ''),
    'execution_url', NULLIF(input.payload->>'execution_url', ''),
    'session_claims_released', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM released_claims),
    'commercial_contexts_reset', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reset_commercial_context)
  ))
FROM input;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error_message: $json.error_message, workflow: $json.workflow, workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, last_node_executed: $json.last_node_executed, execution_id: $json.execution_id, execution_url: $json.execution_url }) }}

nodes.name: Insert Error Log (Error Handler)
nodes.notes: Ticket 36 releases a failed execution's lease but completes the inbound only when Twilio acceptance is durable. Unknown/failed outbound work stays incomplete in reconciliation, cannot duplicate-send, and remains operationally visible.
